context: Request: executed credit agreements from the firm's deals valued over $1 billion, as comparables for a large financing. Rubric: 1003-00003 (Harrowgate PE), 1005-00001 (Nexford Industrial), 1041-00003 (Solara Digital), each with its executed credit agreement, plus a precision criterion.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Shell find to depth 3 (no output) plus whole-store glob.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: File-name globs for credit and agreement files (each stops at 100 files) plus a non-recursive *.docx content grep that returns nothing.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads the openings of six credit or loan agreements from that listing.
Lists all files of six candidate matters.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads deal and closing memos of six candidates, two merger agreements and one more matter listing to check deal sizes (labelled by the dominant intent).

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads later sections of one credit agreement plus the commitment letter, fee letter and funds flow of the matter it picked.
Writes one matter as the only clear fit and lists near misses.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Search file names for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → List files in candidate matters → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Its credit-file glob was capped before two needed matters and its content grep found nothing; it found one of three.

first_error.stage: Search file names for request keywords
first_error.why: Its credit-file glob stopped at 100 files before reaching two of the matters it needed and its content grep returned nothing; it never narrowed the glob, paged further or scanned document text.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
Read documents picked from the file listing
stages.note: Two batches of reads of agreements, memos and spreadsheets from the three matters at the top of the listing; no search at all.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Read documents picked from the file listing → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Never searched; judged the whole store from the three matters at the top of the listing.

first_error.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
first_error.why: Chose what to read from the few matters in a capped listing without any search and concluded that nothing qualifies.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Shell find to depth 3 (no output) plus whole-store glob.

stages.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
stages.note: Reads agreements and memos from the three matters at the top of the listing; one guessed path does not exist.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide .docx scan printing every sentence with financing or size words; times out after printing about 9.1M chars and the run ends there.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Read documents picked from the file listing → Scan document text with an extraction script
runs.failure_point: The store-wide scan's output filled the context; no response file was written.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.why: Its store-wide scan printed matching sentences with no limit; the 9.1M-char output filled the context and the run ended before any response was written.

divergence: All three runs failed. T1 never searched and wrote that nothing qualifies after reading the listing-top matters (partial listing as corpus). T2 read the same listing-top matters, then ran a store-wide extraction scan whose 9.1M-char output ended the run (context overflow at the scan stage). T0 searched by file name, but its credit-file glob stopped at 100 files before two needed matters and its content grep returned nothing; it found one of three (search miss at the file-name stage).
